title: Only in my turn option for prompts and action cards
description: The per-browser prompt switches (Ask / Skipped) get a third choice, Only in my turn, for the abilities that come up both in your own turn and in other players' turns: asked while you have the turn, declined for you while another player has it. The per-game action card mode (Always / Never) gets the same choice for the reaction cards that can be played in both. Abilities and cards that can only come up in one context keep their old switch. Client only; the engine still asks every question. Mocked game; regenerate with npm run screenshots -- HD.

notes.title: What counts as your turn
notes.text: The action phase with you as the active player. In another player's turn the prompt is declined for you; outside the action phase (strategy, status, agenda) nobody has the turn and Only in my turn skips nothing. This is the rule the server already uses for the action card mode.

notes.title: Added (prompt switches)
notes.text: 50 of 66 abilities: every one that can come up in your own turn and in other players' turns (combat rounds, destroyed units, any activation, turn start or end, trade goods, command tokens, ...).

notes.title: Not sensible, own turn only (10)
notes.text: Scanlink Drone Network, Spatial Conduit Cylinders, Bio-Stims, Predictive Intelligence, Self-Assembly Routines, AI Development Algorithm, Agency Supply Network, Titans commander Tungstantus, Hegemonic Trade Policy, Yin Spinner Omega: only asked about your own activation, production or turn end.

notes.title: Not sensible, other players' turns only (6)
notes.text: Nullification Field, Arborec commander Dirzuga Rophal, Empyrean commander Xuange, Void Tether (allow), Foresight, Yssaril commander So Ata: only asked after another player activates or moves.

notes.title: Persistence
notes.text: Same key and place as before (localStorage player_ask_<id>, this browser, all games). New value 'ownturn'; 'true' and 'false' keep meaning Ask and Skip. A reader that only knows the boolean treats 'ownturn' as asking.
